We make financing for everyday essentials accessible to everyone. We strive to drive greater inclusion of women, youth, and low\-income communities.

* **Prosperous** : 70% of customers use M\-KOPA products for income generation, with 35,000 livelihoods created for agents
* **Green** : 2\.1 million tonnes of CO₂ avoided through clean energy products, with over 127,700 circular economy products provided

**Apply now.**

description:

We are a global Data \& AI for Supply Chain Center of Excellence with 200\+ professionals, transforming supply chain operations by turning data into a strategic advantage. Our expertise drives operational optimization, enhanced agility, and smarter decision\-making across global supply chains.  

  

**Our Teams \& Focus Areas**  

  

* Supply Chain Planning – AI\-driven demand forecasting, inventory optimization, and planning solutions to enhance agility and efficiency.
* Fulfillment \& Network Optimization – Advanced analytics to optimize logistics, warehouse management, distribution, network and last\-mile delivery, improving speed, cost, and service levels.
* Manufacturing – AI, machine learning, and IoT to drive predictive maintenance, production efficiency, and quality control in smart manufacturing.

  

**Your role**  

As we continue to grow, we are looking for an experienced Manager to lead teams and projects within our group. In this role, you will oversee client engagements, manage multidisciplinary Data\&AI teams, and contribute to business development, ensuring that our AI\-driven solutions deliver maximum value.


  

**What Skills Are We Looking For?**  

  

We seek analytical, strategic, and impact\-driven leaders passionate about leveraging AI and data to transform supply chains. You should be able to manage client relationships, oversee project execution, and develop new business opportunities while guiding and mentoring teams.  

  

**Basic Qualifications:**  

✔ Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.


✔ Proficiency in English (additional languages are a plus).


✔ 5\+ years of experience in Data \& AI or related fields, with at least 2 years in a leadership or managerial role.


✔ Proven experience in leading teams, client engagements, and business development efforts.  

  

**Technical Skills**  

As a Manager, you should have a strong technical foundation while also being able to drive strategy, oversee execution, and communicate technical insights to stakeholders. You do not need to master all of them but key skills include:

* Programming: Python, R, SQL
* Operation Reasearch \& Simulation: LP, ILP, Heuristics/Meta\-Heuristics, Discrete Events Simulation, digital twins.
* Machine Learning \& AI: Forecasting, predictive modeling, optimization algorithms.
* Generative AI: LLMs, AI\-driven scenario generation, synthetic data modeling, and workflow automation.

As a Manager, you will lead teams, shape AI strategies, and engage with senior stakeholders. Key skills include:  

  

* Leadership \& Team Management: Experience leading multidisciplinary teams (data scientists, engineers, business consultants) and fostering a high\-performance culture.
* Business Acumen \& Strategic Thinking: Ability to connect AI solutions to business impact, optimizing supply chain efficiency, cost, and resilience.
* Client Engagement \& Communication: Skilled at building relationships with senior stakeholders, translating complex analytics into business\-relevant insights.
* Innovation \& Agility: Ability to adapt quickly in fast\-changing environments, driving continuous improvement and innovation. Business Development \& Proposal Management: Experience developing commercial proposals, defining project scopes, and identifying new opportunities.

  

  

**What’s in It for You?**  

  

Join Accenture’s Data \& AI for Supply Chain team and become part of a dynamic and rapidly growing practice where you will:* Lead high\-impact AI \& analytics projects with global clients.
* Work alongside a team of 200\+ data scientists and engineers, including 20% PhDs in Mathematics, Computer Science, Physics, or Statistics.
* Drive cutting\-edge AI innovation, including Generative AI applications in supply chain.
* Enjoy a flexible, hybrid work model in a Great Place to Work®\-recognized company.

  

Additional Benefits:

* Comprehensive insurance (medical, life, and accident).
* Wellness programs and medical services.
* Flexible compensation programs \& stock purchase plans.
* Sustainability initiatives \& Accenture Foundation programs.
* Diversity \& inclusion networks in a globally recognized company.
* Flexibility programs (customized schedules, extra vacation days, etc.).

  

If you are excited about leading AI\-driven transformations in supply chain, we’d love to hear from you!

description:
**About** **JobHire.AI**
JobHire.AI is building a vertical AI agent that automates job search for professionals. We help thousands of users land interviews by finding, tailoring, and applying to jobs on their behalf — at scale and with precision. We’re profitable, growing fast, and now entering a phase of **deep product refinement and organic growth** through exceptional UX and perceived value.


\~35% MoM; top 1% in growth rate


Profitable from day one


40 people


Investors: Deel Ventures, Daniel Gutenberg, Dave Waiser, Margulan Seisembayev, and other unicorn founders.

**Mission**
JobHire.AI is a personal AI agent for continuous professional development and happiness at work

**About the Role**
We are seeking a highly analytical and hands\-on Senior Tech AI/ML Product Manager with deep expertise in Machine Learning and Artificial Intelligence and Product Management. You will define and build a best\-in\-class job discovery and matching engine that connects users with the most relevant roles for them, at scale. You will own the strategy, discovery, and delivery of AI\-powered features, focusing on matching, ranking, and personalization systems. The ideal candidate is an entrepreneurial thinker with an engineering mindset, capable of building rapid prototypes, making decisive calls with imperfect data, and relentlessly driving measurable outcomes.

**Key Responsibilities*** **Strategy \& Ownership:** Define the vision, strategy, and roadmap for AI/ML product features (JobHunt Engine). Take full ownership of the product lifecycle from hypothesis to scaled impact, focusing on business results, not just model performance.
* **ML Product Leadership:** Translate business problems into ML hypotheses and solutions. Work side\-by\-side with ML engineers and data scientists to define data requirements, evaluation frameworks (evals, RAG, agents), model monitoring, and delivery processes.
* **Hypothesis Validation \& Experimentation:** Design and execute rapid, pragmatic validation cycles. Formulate clear hypotheses (Problem Mechanism Impact Metric), choose the right validation method (A/B test, shadow model, phased rollout), and make data\-driven go/no\-go decisions under uncertainty. Be scrappy and effective with limited data or infrastructure.
* **Structured Problem Solving:** Apply critical thinking to decompose complex, ambiguous problems. Cut through noise, prioritize what truly matters, and build simple, effective solutions first.
* **Cross\-Functional Execution:** Collaborate closely with Engineering, Data Science, and business teams. Communicate complex ML concepts clearly and align stakeholders on goals, trade\-offs, and progress.


Expected Outcomes**First 3 Months*** Establish baseline measurement of job supply coverage across the U.S. market, including companies listed in the NASDAQ\-100
* Increase the percentage of users who successfully find a job through the platform by **50%**, driven by improvements in matching logic and job relevance

**First 6 Months*** Expand job vacancy coverage in the U.S. market, achieving up to **80% coverage of NASDAQ\-100 companies** and increasing overall coverage by **30%**
* Ship a major upgrade to the resume enhancement feature
* Increase the percentage of users who successfully found a job through our platform by 3×

**12 Months*** Further expand U.S. job vacancy coverage, achieving a **50% increase** in coverage of NASDAQ\-100 companies compared to the 6\-month baseline
* Double the matching success rate, measured as the percentage of matched vacancies approved as relevant by users
* Improve the **application\-to\-offer conversion rate by 50%**, directly impacting the core business outcome — successful employment

  

**Requirements**  

  

**Requirements*** **Technical \& ML Expertise:**
* + Strong understanding of ML/LLM fundamentals (NLP, recommendation systems, etc.).
	+ Hands\-on experience building and scaling AI\-powered features (matching, ranking, personalization).
	+ Practical knowledge of modern AI/ML concepts: evaluation frameworks, RAG, agents, model monitoring.
	+ Ability to define data pipelines, metrics, and work processes with ML engineering teams.
* + Nice to have: hands\-on experience in a Data Science, Data Analyst, or ML Engineer role.

* **Product Development:**
* + **5\+ years of experience in a Product Manager role,** preferably in a data\-intensive or ML\-driven domain (HRTech experience is a strong plus).
	+ Proven ability to formulate and rigorously test product/ML hypotheses using statistical methods (A/B testing, significance, confidence intervals).
	+ Ability to reason about probability, causality, and data limitations to make informed decisions.

* **Mindset \& Approach:**
* + **Entrepreneurial \& Hands\-on:** "Let's build it" attitude. Able to create quick prototypes and test ideas without over\-engineering. Comfortable with "building with sticks and glue" to learn fast.
	+ **Outcome\-Oriented:** Owns the business result, not just the AI model. Pragmatic and willing to simplify or kill features that don't drive impact.
	+ **Thrives in Ambiguity:** Can navigate uncertainty, contradictory model results, and noisy data. Structured thinker who can bring clarity to complex situations.

* **Communication:** Fluent English and Russian. Excellent ability to communicate with technical (Engineers, Data Scientists) and non\-technical stakeholders.

**Our Ideal Candidate*** Thinks simultaneously about business metrics and model quality metrics.
* Has a super\-engineer mindset coupled with an entrepreneurial, "get things done" approach.
* Takes responsibility for the end result, not just the AI model.
* Doesn't fall in love with technology but stays focused on solving the problem.
* Their first reaction to an idea is "Let's go build and test it."

**We keep our hiring process quick and simple:**

* HR Introduction Call
* Team Interviews
* Product challenge
* Reference Check (with three prior managers)

  

**Benefits**  

* JobHire.AI is a **mission\-driven, fastest\-growing, and profitable global company**.
* Amazing opportunity to build Job Hunt Engine, shaping the future of AI HRtech, people’s careers and lives.
* Brilliant team of the strongest A players from McKinsey, Nexters, Gett, Glovo.
* Remote work \- work/life balance.
* Competitive package ($100\-150k \+ Equity).
* 38 days Off (vacation \+ local holidays) and sick leave.

En Kelea estamos en constante crecimiento y nos encantará conocerte para que en cuanto se active una oportunidad, tengamos tu perfil muy en el radar para contactar contigo y dar el pistoletazo de salida   

 Buscamos conocerte, compartir experiencias, aprendizajes e inquietudes ¡Quién sabe si **Kelea.Tech** es tu próxima aventura profesional y tú eres la pieza que necesitamos para impulsar nuestros proyectos!
Requisitos


**¿Qué perfiles encajan en nuestros retos?**  

Si tienes experiencia en alguno de estos roles, sin duda podremos hacer match en algún proyecto:  

  

* **Data Scientist**: experiencia previa en Machine Learning para modelos avanzados de detección fraude y anomalías.
* **IAGen Engineer**: Experiencia en proyectos reales de IA Generativa, y comprensión de los modelos de LLM.
* **Data Engineer**: experiencia en el análisis, diseño, desarrollo y optimización de procesos ETL, plataformas de almacenamiento y procesamiento de datos, así como herramientas de visualización y análisis.
* **Data Analyst**: experiencia en consultas y optimización de bbdd, modelado, streaming y gestión de datos en tiempo real.

  

  

**¿Que comparten todos nustros proyectos?** Un stack tecnológico muy puntero* Lenguaje principal: Python
* Streaming y gestión de datos en tiempo real.
* Arquitecturas de datos distribuidas (Kafka, Spark, Flink, etc.)
* BBDD SQL y NoSQL
* Experiencia trabajando en Cloud: Azure, AWS o GPC.

 **﻿¿Por qué unirte a Kelea?*** **Proyectos**:en Kelea acompañamos a empresas grandes (tamaño ibex 35\) de diferentes sectores en el lanzamiento de nuevos productos y servicios que les ayuden a ser competitivos en sus mercados.

* **Tecnologías**: trabajamos en entornos donde se apuesta por desarrollar soluciones digitales con un enfoque de trabajo no tradicional y aplicando las últimas tecnologías.

* **Un modelo diferente de consultoría**: somos una consultora especialista con un modelo organizativo orientado en las personas. Nos organizamos por círculos buscando que los equipos trabajen con autonomía y autogestión. Fomentamos la transparencia y la accesibilidad en la comunicación. Creemos en un estilo de liderazgo diferente en donde no existe la figura de jefe sino de líder.

* **Nuestros valores**: te los contamos en el siguiente**VÍDEO** ️.
